subject: FoundrHub — Onramp credit boost for Cohort 2
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina@foundrhub.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Joel Kim <joel@fundable.vc>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: one-time onramp credit boost for Cohort 2

Hi Neha,

Hope you’re well — FoundrHub’s Cohort 2 kicks off next Friday and we just scoped a weekend hands-on workshop that will spike API usage for ~48 hours. We’ve been thrilled with the trial pilots — instructors want to run full model-backed exercises and the students will hit higher token volumes than originally forecast.

Quick ask: is there a path for a one-time, short window credit boost (two weeks max) scoped to this cohort? High-level details:
- Purpose: weekend workshop + demo day prep
- Expected incremental usage: ~150k tokens across 20 teams over 48 hours (spike) + lower steady usage for 2 weeks
- Commitment: demo-day integration and case study if we hit engagement targets

I’ve attached the cohort schedule and a quick runbook (cohort-schedule.pdf) for context. If there’s any qualification checklist we should complete, happy to return it ASAP — Joel is copied in for procurement/legal if needed.

Thanks,
Lina Park
Partnerships, FoundrHub

Attachment: cohort-schedule.pdf (application/pdf, stub)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@foundrhub.com>
Cc: Joel Kim <joel@fundable.vc>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time onramp credit boost for Cohort 2

Hi Lina — great timing, congrats on the kickoff.

We can usually support short, targeted boosts for accelerator cohorts that commit to a demo-day integration and a brief post-program writeup. To move quickly, can you confirm two things:
1) A quantifiable engagement milestone we can tie the boost to (e.g., 80% of teams submit a demo that calls the API at least once).
2) Who in your procurement/legal team signs a short MOU (I can attach our onboarding-milestone agreement).

Tentatively we can offer a one-time credit increase in the range of 15–25k tokens for the spike window, with a secondary smaller runway for follow-up. If that scope works, I’ll loop in Karthik and Marissa to fast-track approvals.

I attached a draft onboarding-milestone-agreement.pdf (stub) — please review and flag changes.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Startup Programs Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: onboarding-milestone-agreement.pdf (application/pdf, stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 11:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: one-time onramp credit boost for Cohort 2

Neha / Marissa —

Quick internal: I’m comfortable approving a limited boost for this cohort under these conditions:
- One-time spike window credit: 25,000 tokens (used during the weekend workshop only)
- Follow-up runway: additional 10,000 tokens usable over the next 14 days
- Customer commitment: sign MOU and agree to a short case study if they pass the engagement milestone (tie to deal ID DEAL-8742)
- Legal: simple MOU is fine; procurement to confirm billing contact

I’ve attached an approval memo we can drop into HubSpot for traceability (credits-approval-memo.docx). If legal needs edits to the MOU, loop them in but I’d prefer not to delay the workshop.

If you agree, Neha — can you confirm the exact start/end timestamps so I can mark the boost window on our billing rules?

— Karthik
Head of Startup Programs, Redwood Inference

Attachment: credits-approval-memo.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@foundrhub.com>, Joel Kim <joel@fundable.vc>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 13:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time onramp credit boost for Cohort 2

Hi Lina / Joel — great to connect on this. We’ve approved a temporary credit boost under the terms Karthik outlined. Details below (official confirmation):

- Boost: 25,000 token credit active for the workshop window
- Runway: additional 10,000 token credit available for 14 days after the workshop
- Window start: 2027-11-20T08:00:00-08:00 (PST)
- Window end: 2027-11-22T08:00:00-08:00 (PST)
- Conditions: Signed onboarding-milestone-agreement and agreement to a short case study if engagement milestone is met

Attachments: grant-confirmation.pdf (stub), usage-guidelines.md (stub) — the grant confirmation includes the DocuSign link for the MOU and the HubSpot deal is updated (see link below). Please have your procurement/legal sign the MOU by EOD Wednesday to ensure the boost is active for the workshop.

DocuSign: https://app.redwood.com/docs/docusign/DEAL-8742
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/8742

If you’d like, I can schedule a 20-minute troubleshooting/onboarding call immediately after the workshop to review any performance anomalies — when is your team free on Monday?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sales Lead, Startup Programs
Redwood Inference
